rules.name: hoeja_discussion_2026-11-02
rules.note: 1.2.1 editor rule. Articles whose quote is about the 回咨 — the reply dispatch sent to the Qing Board of Rites after an eclipse had passed (日食已過, 禮部回咨 …) — are administrative mentions of a past eclipse, i.e. discussion under both codebooks. Coder batches split on them (lunar sjw_4/5/8/9 → forecast/report_order, sjw_6/7 and the blind coder → discussion; solar sjw_9 → forecast, one sjw_8 row → observed). Found by the 1.2 blind verification (C-일식-18, C-월식-03, C-월식-08). The coder's type is kept in type_coder.
rules.note_1.2.2: Round-2 blind verification (2026-11-02) found articles of the same kind that the regex misses because the quote/summary has no 回咨: the Qing notice arriving after the eclipse (日食已過, 救食咨文, 今纔出來), the reply being late (救食後登時回咨 ... 咨文, 尙不出來), 咨文依前例 after 月蝕已過, and one spelling 回資. The Ilgi itself states the rule (SJW-J13110130: 大國咨文, 前期出來, 救食後登時回咨) - the notice comes in advance, the reply goes after the rite - so a reply dispatch is by definition administration of a past eclipse. Articles about forwarding the advance notice itself before the eclipse (e.g. 月食不遠, 此等咨文; 來月月食咨文) stay forecast. article_ids lists the 13 rows read in the original and added by hand; 資 added to the regex (SJW-H24060010, coded observed). All ids were read in the NIKH XML.

rules.name: jaegye_ritual_2026-11-02
rules.note: 1.2.2 editor rule. Articles whose quote is about 齋戒 (ritual abstinence on an eclipse day - a lecture, audience or rite postponed because 日食齋戒相値, including 地下日食齋戒 when the eclipse itself is below the horizon) were coded ritual by most batches (solar 72, lunar 226) but forecast by some (solar 21, lunar 4). Round-2 verification flagged the split (C-S01 vs C-L10). Under both codebooks the content is ritual observance, not a forecast, so forecast -> ritual. Excluded: SJW-A16050070 (lunar; the article is the below-horizon computation and the decision not to hold 救食 - forecast per the below_horizon boundary). Coder type kept in type_coder.
